headSubject: chore(ledger): QUAL-43 API-key merge fix confirmed on live CI; file QUAL-45/46 for the two new failure layers it exposed
summary: Closed out the 5 open ledger items (QUAL-36/40/41/42, SEC-3 scoped): QUAL-36's Docker daemon-unreachable-on-Windows misclassification and QUAL-42's base-ai-loop 401 both root-caused and fixed. Verifying each fix on live CI uncovered a chain of 5 more real, previously-CI-unreachable bugs, each fixed and verified (not just code-read): QUAL-43 (Ensure-NpdevApiKey clobbered then, after a wrong first fix caught by CI, needed to MERGE real per-testUser API keys with its own fallback key), QUAL-44 (sample-matrix-tests: a missing corpus-roles classification + a stale negative schema fixture), QUAL-45 ( derivation bug from QUAL-43's own merge, plus a real generator bug: entityFromRecord in service-base.mustache never rehydrated tenantId from ConceptRecord, dropping it from every CREATE response on the ConceptGateway read path), QUAL-46 (3 golden scenarios' verification fixtures checked a stale /api/users endpoint that never existed in their model). QUAL-40/41 closed WONTFIX per owner decision.
nextStep: Check background task bmxz1ppg6 (run-generator-gate.ps1, dispatched ~20:37 UTC 2026-08-31, digest log under D:\WorkSpace\NPDev\Build\digest-logs) - it validates the service-base.mustache entityFromRecord fix doesn't break generator reference-output tests. If green: commit+push the 6 uncommitted files (NPDevGenerator/generator/.../service-base.mustache, golden-ai-scenarios/{custom-panel-procedure-mismatch,custom-procedure-admission-rejection,custom-procedure-invalid}/ai-verification-report.json, ledger/items/QUAL-45.yml, scripts/quality/invoke-ai-beta-app-smoke.ps1), then dispatch one more fresh 'gh workflow run ai-beta-gate.yml --ref main' to confirm QUAL-43/44/45/46 together on live CI - tenant-service-desk/tenant-approval-portal and the 3 custom-procedure scenarios share the same fixes but were never independently live-verified. If the generator gate is red, diagnose before pushing.
blocked: Nothing genuinely blocked - run-generator-gate.ps1 was still in progress at session close, result not yet known.
verified: Local: tenant-workflow-ops single-scenario live boot fully green after QUAL-45's fixes (was 1 of 9 checks failing); sample-matrix-tests green after QUAL-44's fixes; check-done-item-guards.py and check-ledger-status-reverse-freshness.py both clean. Live CI: QUAL-36 fix confirmed on 2 runs (docker-linux-proof correctly reports skipped); QUAL-42 confirmed (base-ai-loop passes on Docker/Linux, not just Windows-local); QUAL-43's corrected merge fix confirmed (create-ticket 201, custom-panel-unsupported regression from the first wrong fix is gone). run-generator-gate.ps1 dispatched but result unknown at close.
